title: Promoted fields and methods
hints: The tests use c.ID and c.Describe() on a Container, and build it with Container{Base: Base{…}}. Those only work if Base is embedded, not stored in a named field.
An embedded field is written as just a type name, with no field name: `Base` on its own line inside the struct. Its fields and methods are promoted, and the field is named after the type.
